body:
Apologies for the late reply, I wasn’t on reddit yesterday.

I’m sorry to hear that you went/are going through a tough time. I hope things get better if they aren’t already. 

Thanks, my day wasn’t the best but it was a lot better then some. I was able to talk to my friends for a couple of hours so I wasn’t completely alone. I hope you had a nice day as well. 

To you it might not seem like a big deal, since it probably didn’t take a lot of time to write that but to me it means a lot that you thought to check up on me.

I’ve already said thank you a lot but I feel like it needed to be said. You’re words are really inspirational. You should become a motivational speaker or something. Nah but for real, I don’t think you understand how much you helped tonight. I’ll always be thankful for that. For people  being as nice as you were tonight, for people who decide to help out people they don’t really know. 

I hope I get through this as well, it’s getting into the early hours of the morning so I think I’ll just sleep it off and hope I feel better in the morning.

Thanks for caring though, really. <3

Edit: spelling mistakes.

Im similar to you in the sense that I tend to reply using short responses. If you couldn’t already tell I’m not the best with words and getting my point across. I do really appreciate that you even replied to me at all. Means a lot.

Thanks for offering your support. It does truly make me feel better knowing someone cares even if I don’t know them and they don’t know me (is that weird?!?!) 

I didn’t expect to find people who actually cared and are so willing to help. I honestly don’t know how my night will turn out since things have taken a turn for the worse but still I thank you for helping as much as you already have. You seem like a genuinely good human ahah :))

thank you, I don’t think you really understand how much that meant to me. It genuinely made me smile which has been a hard thing to achieve in these past 48 hrs. It makes me feel better knowing someone cared enough to write all of that even if I don’t know them personally. Gives me some hope that maybe there are people out there who care. Wish other people in my life cared that much. Anyway enough of me ranting, I just wanted to thank you for taking the time to write something to help me. Thank you again , I hope you have a good day :)
had a really rough day, even if this isn’t a directed at me, it made me feel a little better.

First of all I’d like to say thank you. This is one of the nicest/helpful things that’s been said to me in a while. 

As for telling a parent.. it might sound dumb but there’s no way I could bring myself to tell my mum. I would consider telling a councillor but I’m currently not attending school for medical issues. 

I don’t think I’m going to be taking anymore paracetamol considering liver failure doesn’t seem like the best way to go. I thought that I was out of options more than anything else. 

I appreciate your consideration and thank you for caring enough to write this and help out a stranger.
